doc: Merged by port/src/norm_timings.py from effects/timings_CDHL.json and effects/timings_MPST.json (the 2026-11-03 rebuild of the effects on the gate-1 board). Times in ms at 60 fps on the effect clock. Ease codes map to Godot Tween TRANS / EASE pairs (GODOT_PORT_SPEC.md 8.1). fx_shield_block appears once: the MPST P-family effect; the CDHL copy is the block-vs-break comparison only. reduce_phases are data for M/P/S/T; C/D/H/L keep one still per effect, described in reduce_motion.
tier_vfx: T2 for every effect (VfxTier T2 outcome, max 0.6 s; REVIEW_RESPONSE 2.11)
layer_rule: every effect draws under the HUD and the hand (f1_render.SPLIT below / above); only fx_hp_through, fx_refund, fx_trace_add may draw above the HUD (review 1.6)

p_stock.why: review 3.10: the FX-P plate on its own stock, a pink-tinted paper, not the card bone PAPER #F2EEE4

loudness_rule: damage > kill > block > state (gain ranks with state)
loudness_metric: peak over the 60 fps frames of sum(L*/100) over the pixels where the frame differs (dE76 > 5) from both the frame without the effect and the settled frame (the transient); unit full-value px

neutral.rule: damage > kill > block > state (gain ranks with state)

solace.rule: damage > kill > block > state (gain ranks with state)

meridian.rule: damage > kill > block > state (gain ranks with state)

effects.title: Brace blocks a whole landing

reduce_phases.name: lane, clamp brackets, bar, crumpled chevrons and stamp appear

effects.title: SHIELD slice absorbs a landing

reduce_phases.name: plate, ticks and stopped chevrons appear

Measured: this form counts 1 flash per s, as full motion (the 0-200 / 300-600 form counted 2).

resolve_beat.skip: any input: the frame dissolves (easeInOutCubic) to the settled frame in skip_ms; no on-screen word (open question for the designer)
resolve_beat.order: concurrent tracks in the HUD chain order (SEND IT, 1 TWIST, 2 TRIGGER, 4 GUNS, 3 BRACE + 5 LANDS, 6 RINGS STEP, W4 enters); every effect at its own designer's timing, each <= 600 ms
resolve_beat.not_to_ship: ring +1 drawn one sector back from SEND IT until Twist turns it (f2 holds ring +1 where Twist leaves it): a RULES question (REVIEW_RESPONSE "Shove bump, Twist render"); the strip and the GIF caption say so
